description.from:
Low-priority cleanups for the live p.apyr.us and read.p.apyr.us sites (no dedicated board; filed on Papyrus).

- [ ] https://read.p.apyr.us/icon.png, /icon-light.png and /favicon.ico return 404. Publish the icons or remove the references.
- [ ] The read.p.apyr.us home page title is the marketing title; give the reader its own title.
- [ ] read.p.apyr.us article deks show raw backticks (for example /articles/howto-curate-references). Render inline code or strip the markers.
- [ ] https://p.apyr.us/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return 403; https://read.p.apyr.us/sitemap.xml returns 404. Serve both.

**How to verify**
`for p in icon.png icon-light.png favicon.ico sitemap.xml robots.txt; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}
" https://read.p.apyr.us/$p; done` shows 200 for each, and `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://p.apyr.us/robots.txt` returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
